newsitem.title: USA: Judge rules in favor of Capitol, Conseco.
newsitem.headline: Judge rules in favor of Capitol, Conseco.

text.p: Capitol American Financial Corp said Tuesday that the Superior Court in Maricopa County, Ariz., had on Monday ruled in favor of the company's merger with Conseco Inc

The court held that the plaintiff, Loren Hershey, had not produced sufficient evidence that the proposed merger was contrary to the law, or inequitable to either the shareholders of Capitol's American Life Insurance Co subsidiary, or the shareholders of the parent company, Capitol said.
However, Capitol said the automatic stay preventing consummation of the merger remains temporarily in effect pending further court proceedings and a possible appeal by the plaintiff.
Capitol American Financial Corporation is a provider of supplemental accident and health insurance.
